name: La'ro
source:
La'ro is the refined and cultured owner of the Wayfarer's Rest, a popular bar and nightspot on the Hesperides. Being from the Galactic Assembly's capital planet of Alahala, he is incredibly knowledgeable about the food and cultures of the galaxy's many species. Whether or not he's willing to share that knowledge with his new rival is an entirely different matter.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/330388878/love-at-the-milky-way-diner/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
